Home / Services

Services for property owners in Chennai.

Each service can stand alone or be combined into one management plan. The pages below say what is included, how the process runs, what you receive, and what sits outside the agreement.

Complete Property Management

One agreed plan covering inspections, tenants, maintenance and owner updates.

Tenant Management

Enquiries, screening coordination, onboarding, communication and move-outs.

Rental Management

Rent follow-ups, payment-status updates, renewal reminders and paperwork.

Property Inspection

Scheduled visits with dated photographs, observations and recommendations.

Maintenance & Repairs

Plumbing, electrical, painting, cleaning, carpentry and pest control, coordinated with your approval.

Vacant Property Care

Regular visits, ventilation, cleaning and condition updates while nobody lives there.

NRI Property Management

Remote communication, inspection updates and on-the-ground coordination for owners abroad.

Interior Improvements & Refurbishment

Coordination of approved improvement work with vendors and professionals.

What is never included

Legal representation, tax advice, property valuation, structural certification and regulated financial services are not part of any Flourrish plan. Where a matter needs one of these, we say so and can suggest independent professionals. Vendor charges for repairs and improvements are always separate from the management fee and are paid by the owner.

Not sure which service fits?

Describe the property and what is bothering you about it. We will suggest a scope.
